scoring_justification: Agent emits summary test MSE and MAE per mesh type; no raw predictions available. Compare reported metrics to paper gold with threshold_or_better and partial credit.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported test MSE and MAE for N=48 hidden neurons per mesh type, extracted from Figures 7 and 8.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual extraction from figures; values are approximate but within visual accuracy.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published experimental results; using them as gold is faithful to the paper.

outputs.description: Averaged test MSE and MAE for each mesh type over three random seeds. Lower values correspond to better predictive accuracy. The checker compares these numbers against paper-reported references with a tolerance factor: target ≤ reference × 1.5.

output_contract.notes: Only the final test metrics are scored. The synthetic dataset generation and model training must be executed by the agent; no pre-made artifacts are provided.

steps.description: Compare reported MSE and MAE for four mesh types against paper gold with tolerance factor 1.5. Score = fraction of metrics meeting threshold (8 metrics total).
